protocol.purpose: Trace a fixed residual vector through native SwiGLU units and test candidate groups by blocking and restoration on held-out problems.
protocol.injection_scope: last input position only, fixed prefix, use_cache=False
protocol.dose_rule: alpha = strength * baseline block-input L2 norm; both signs and all random directions use that same alpha
protocol.system_prompt: Check the multiplication equation. Reply with exactly one capital letter: A if the equation is correct, B if the equation is incorrect. Do not add any other text.
protocol.primary_outcome: log P(correct answer-letter set) - log P(incorrect answer-letter set), full model logits; also report unconditional P(correct), answer-set coverage and argmax classification
protocol.candidate_selection: For every downstream MLP, rank units by discovery-mean abs(a_steered-a_baseline) * L2(down_proj column); take 32. Use +v at primary strength only; no evaluation outcomes enter selection.
patches: joint restore selected units during baseline
protocol.patch_scope: Only final-position down_proj inputs; natural donor products from the same prefix. Joint patches recompute the receiving run sequentially.
protocol.random_group_rule: Seeded disjoint units at the same layers and count; match discovery activation-magnitude quartile and down-column-norm quartile, disclose fallback matching. Per layer scale the random product displacement to the selected patch's actual residual-write L2 norm.

aime_transfer.positions: first two original R6 sample_markers positions whose complete prefix is <=2048 tokens
aime_transfer.outcome: full-softmax marker-set logprob, raw marker LSE separately; no answer-correctness conclusion
aime_transfer.patches: joint block and restore plus four matched random groups; groups are frozen from synthetic discovery

guards: nonempty disjoint discovery and evaluation problem sets
protocol.reporting: Report every fixed cell, failures and missing transfer sites. Equal-weight problems before averaging wording and truth conditions. Descriptive paired effects and per-problem ranges; no post-hoc significance gate or single-label semantic identification. Blocking and restoration are distinct effects, not additive percentages of mechanism.
